title: Evolve Where It Matters: Coverage-Guided Self-Evolution of Agent Skills
title_zh: 在关键处改进：覆盖率引导的智能体技能自演化
abstract_en: Agent skills package procedural knowledge as natural-language instructions, and a skill helps only when its instructions are correct and properly followed by the agent. Self-evolving agents revise their own skills from the runs they make, but existing methods judge each run as a whole, by its outcome or by where it went wrong, and cannot tell whether a failure comes from a wrong instruction or from one the agent did not follow. Instruction-level coverage was introduced to test skills and labels each instruction of a run as follow, not-follow, or not covered, which separates these causes. We leverage it for skill self-evolution with SkillPlumber, a framework in which an agent evolves its own skills where coverage shows they fall short. A persistent root cause analysis agent turns each label into a revision question and checks each revision against the next run, while a maintainer distills investigations across tasks into a shared strategy library. Across three benchmarks and three executors, SkillPlumber solves 64.7% to 70.5% of the tasks, 25.6 to 30.4 percentage points higher than the initial skill and 8.7 to 14.0 percentage points higher than the strongest baseline, and removing coverage reduces recovered failures by 20.8% on SkillsBench with GPT-5.5.
abstract_zh: 智能体技能（agent skills）以自然语言指令封装操作知识。技能要发挥作用，指令既要正确，也要被智能体遵循。现有自演化方法根据任务结果或出错位置评估整次运行，难以区分指令本身有误和智能体未遵循指令。SkillPlumber 将指令级覆盖率（instruction-level coverage）用于技能自演化，在每次运行中将各条指令标记为已遵循（follow）、未遵循（not-follow）或未覆盖（not covered），以帮助区分失败原因。持续运行的根因分析智能体将覆盖标签转化为具体的修订问题，并在下一次运行中验证修订效果；维护智能体则将跨任务的分析经验提炼为共享策略库。在三个基准和三种执行器上，SkillPlumber 的任务成功率为 64.7%–70.5%，比初始技能高 25.6–30.4 个百分点，比最强基线高 8.7–14.0 个百分点。在 SkillsBench 上使用 GPT-5.5 时，移除覆盖率信号使成功挽回的失败案例数减少 20.8%。
key_points_zh: 将评估粒度从整次运行细化到单条指令，区分已遵循、未遵循和未覆盖。
SkillPlumber 根据覆盖标签提出修订问题，在下一次运行中验证修改，并将跨任务经验沉淀为共享策略库。
在三个基准和三种执行器上，任务成功率为 64.7%–70.5%，较最强基线提升 8.7–14.0 个百分点。
在 SkillsBench 和 GPT-5.5 的组合下，移除覆盖率信号后，成功挽回的失败案例数减少 20.8%。
